calendar.scope_error:
❌ Insufficient permissions! The current Google account does not have Calendar permission.

🔧 How to fix:
1. Go to Auth Manager → Click your Google credential
2. Re-authorize with the scope: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar
3. Or create a new credential with Calendar scope enabled

📋 Required scope: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar
